shortDescription: Bihar Legislative Council Vidhan Parishad Sachivalaya recruitment result is available for Stenographer, DEO and other post-related results. Candidates can download the result PDF from the official website.
content:
Bihar Legislative Council Vidhan Parishad Sachivalaya has released the result for the recruitment of Assistant Branch Officer, Data Entry Operator (DEO) and Stenographer posts.

The examination was conducted under the Bihar Vidhan Parishad recruitment process for 2024 and related follow-up announcements. Candidates can check the official result PDFs for Stenographer, DEO, LDC and PA result notices from the official Bihar Vidhan Parishad portal.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 12/03/2024
  • Last date to apply online: 06/04/2024
  • Fee payment last date: 06/04/2024
  • Re-open apply online: 18-27 September 2024
  • Exam date: 20, 27 October 2024
  • Result available: 13/01/2025
  • ASO exam date: 23/05/2025
  • ASO admit card: 21/05/2025

Use the official website and the result links below to verify the candidate list, roll numbers and the next verification steps.
